sources.title: Multi-Modal Data-Efficient 3D Scene Understanding for Autonomous ...
sources.snippet: Overview This paper presents a multi-modal data-efficient approach for 3D scene understanding in autonomous driving. The method leverages both LiDAR and camera data to achieve robust and accurate 3D semantic segmentation. It employs a semi-supervised learning strategy to reduce the need for costly annotated data.
